Usability testing is `a user research method where real people interact with a product while researchers observe their behavior to find design flaws and improve the user experience`.[[1]](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/software-testing/usability-testing/)[[2]](https://www.usertesting.com/resources/guides/usability-testing)

### Key Types of Usability Testing

- **Moderated vs. Unmoderated:** Moderated tests feature a live guide who asks questions, while unmoderated tests let users complete tasks independently via software.[[1]](https://www.ranorex.com/blog/exploring-5-types-of-usability-testing/)[[2]](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/software-testing/usability-testing/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u261LfnxGF0&t=144)
- **Remote vs. In-Person:** Remote tests happen online through video or testing tools, whereas in-person tests take place in a controlled physical lab.[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/usability-testing)[[2]](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/software-testing/usability-testing/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u261LfnxGF0&t=144)
- **Qualitative vs. Quantitative:** Qualitative methods capture user feelings and verbal feedback, while quantitative methods track numbers like task completion time and error rates.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7pAOkWLW1Oo&t=215)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u261LfnxGF0&t=144)

### Core Steps to Conduct a Test

1. **Define goals:** Choose specific tasks and performance questions you want to answer.
2. **Recruit participants:** Find 3 to 5 people who match your target user group.
3. **Create a script:** Write clear, unbiased scenarios for users to perform.
4. **Run the test:** Watch users navigate the product and note where they struggle.
5. **Analyze and iterate:** Review findings to fix problems and update the design.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/usability-testing-101/)[[2]](https://www.dhs.gov/cx/learning-trainings/cx-learning/usability-testing-topics/what-is-usability-testing)[[3]](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/software-testing/usability-testing/)[[4]](https://digital.gov/guides/plain-language/test/usability-testing)[[5]](https://www.usertesting.com/resources/guides/usability-testing)

For more details, check out the [Usability Testing 101 Guide](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/usability-testing-101/) or the [Complete Guide to Usability Testing](https://www.usertesting.com/resources/guides/usability-testing).[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/usability-testing-101/)[[2]](https://www.usertesting.com/resources/guides/usability-testing)If you want to plan a test, tell me:

- What **kind of product** (website, mobile app, physical item) are you testing?
- Do you prefer a **remote or in-person** setup?

I can help you write your first set of test tasks.
